sentences.text: 3. The prosecution case as per the written statement of  the informant-opposite party no.2 given to the Officer-In-  Charge, Yadopur Police Station on 2.7.2018 alleges inter alia  that the informant was married to Dr. Bipin Bihari Pandey on  28.11.2002 .
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: Having lost the divorce case in the Court, the informant states that her husband called her on 10.4.2018, used to keep her locked up in a room and also assaulted her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: She was threatened that if she did not give statement in writing, as demanded by him, her children would be killed.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: Contrary to the Court's order, her husband married the petitioner no.3 and was having illicit relations with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: The informant further states that the petitioner nos.1 and 2 along with her husband Dr. Bipin Bihari Pandey and petitioner no.3, on 29.6.2018 at about 12 noon locked her and her children in separate rooms and brutally assaulted her with an intention to kill.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: They had kept a sack with the intention that they would dispose of the dead body in it.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: They had also threatened to kill the informant's father and brother.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text:
As such the F.I.R.

sentences.text: 5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioner nos.1 and 2 happen to be the compounders and petitioner no.3 happens to be the nurse, all of whom are working in the clinic of the husband of the opposite party no.2 who is a doctor.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the material on record, this Court finds that in the instant application the petitioners have challenged the order dated 16.12.2019 taking cognizance in the case, in connection with Yadopur P.S. Case no.62 of 2018.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: From perusal of the contents of the F.I.R. it transpires that there is specific allegation against the three petitioners herein.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: While it is stated that the husband of the informant was having an illicit affair with the petitioner no.3 who happens to be his nurse, the petitioner nos.1 and 2 were working in the capacity of compounder in the clinic of the informant's husband who is a doctor.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: Further specific allegations have been levelled against all the three petitioners that they along with the husband of the informant locked up the informant in a room and also assaulted her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: The allegations levelled in the F.I.R. have been supported by the informant in her further statement, by the minor son of the informant and also by an independent witness.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: 8. Thus, the Court finds that substantial material has transpired against the petitioners in course of investigation and having perused the same, the learned trial Court has rightly taken cognizance in the case by its order dated 16.12.2019, Patna High Court CR.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: MISC. No.71178 of 2022 dt.12-07-2024 impugned herein.
sentences._hearing_file: Mrityunjay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024.json

sentences.text: 9. The Court finds no merit in the instant application and the same is dismissed.
